draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Payyanur! It was the first municipality in Kerala to set up libraries in every one of its wards. The town sits on the Perumba River, close to the Kavvayi backwaters.
draft.hungryLine: Payyanur has great small eats. Try Babuvettan's Thattukada for muttayappam, or the Kudumbashree Restaurant run by village women.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Muthappan Temple is a 1 min walk. Kavvayi Island is about 2 km away, in the largest backwaters of north Kerala.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Take the island walk on Kavvayi Island, or ride a slow passenger train toward Kannur and watch the villages go by.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Kavvayi Island was originally named Kavvil Pattanam. Sir William Hogan, then district collector of Hosdurg, renamed it.

legends.title: Eleven Theyyams
legends.body: It's the main temple among 11 Kannangad temples, and about 11 Theyyams perform here. The festival comes only once every two years.

legends.title: Poorakkali
legends.body: Poorakkali is an ancient dance festival of this area. Look for Theyyam too, in select temples during the right season.

tips.title: Time it for Theyyam season.
tips.body: Theyyam happens in select temples only in the right season, so ask locally.

tips.title: Take the passenger train.
tips.body: Slow trains stop at every small station between Payyanur and Kannur, and they're cheap and punctual.

story.title: Kavvil Pattanam
story.body: The island now called Kavvayi was first named Kavvil Pattanam. Sir William Hogan, district collector of Hosdurg, gave it the name Kavvayi.

story.title: Family houses
story.body: Old family houses like Iruttan Tharavad and Aramana Tharavad still stand at Kandoth, about 6 km away.

story.title: A new taluk
story.body: On 10 March 2018, Chief Minister Pinarayi Vijayan inaugurated Payyanur as the fifth taluk in Kannur district. It takes in 22 villages.

story.title: A library in every ward
story.body: Payyanur was the first municipality in Kerala to set up libraries in all its wards. Drop into one if you want a quiet hour.
